#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

void solve() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    std::vector<int> t(111, 0); // 1-indexed, size 111 to allow index up to 110
    int nr = 0;

    while (m > 0) {
        nr++;
        t[nr] = m % w;
        m = m / w;
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= nr; i++) {
        if (t[i] > w / 2) {
            t[i] = -(t[i] - w);
            t[i + 1]++;
        }
    }

    if (t[nr] == 1) {
        nr++;
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= nr; i++) {
        if (t[i] > 1) {
            std::cout << "NO" << std::endl;
            return;
        }
    }

    std::cout << "YES" << std::endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
